messages:
maria: Kicking off canary for release v3.2.4 in the 18:00 UTC change window. deploy-bot started the traffic shift to canary-2. Watch SLO dashboards (p95, 5xx, error budget burn) and embeddings route specifically (/v1/embeds-large). :eyes:

deploy-bot: Started rollout 3.2.4 -> canary-2, step 1/4. routing: 5% -> canary-2. Logs & dashboards: https://internal.dash/redwood/canary/4839876543

sre-bot: Alert rule "embed-service_p95_high" firing for canary-2: p95 latency = 1880ms (>1500ms) over 3m window. count=74. link: https://alerts.host/alert/98321

jason: seeing same on traces, correlated to kvcache miss rate bump. sample trace id: trace-279af. snippet: `kv_cache.miss_rate 0.47 -> 0.72 after shift`

oliver: Copy. Is this affecting only /v1/embeds-large or also text-gen?

maria: mainly embeds so far. text-gen p95 stable.

kim: Can we reduce canary percent back to 1% while we triage? Or pin canary to quantized-variant to test perf diff?

maria: Try lowering first. deploy-bot, throttle back to 1% and pause further steps.

deploy-bot: Rolling back traffic to 1% for canary-2. Paused further steps. (action-id: a-4839876543-1)

sre-bot: FYI auto-sentinel captured 5xx spike at 18:03:12 for embed-route, count=12 in 2m. Top error: `ERR_BATCH_TIMEOUT`

jason: posting a quick repro curl and headers for devs to simulate load:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/embeds-large \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"input": ["lorem ipsum"], "model": "embed-large-v2"]}'
```

oliver: I can run the repro against canary-2 in staging cluster. If kvcache keys warm up it may drop. Also adding a small tweak to sampling: reduce batch_timeout from 120ms -> 80ms as quick test?

kim: If batch_timeout change looks risky, prefer traffic pin to embed-large-v1 fallback for canary users (no config change). Maria, do you want a rollback to v3.2.3 or partial pin?

maria: Let's avoid full rollback for now. Action plan: 1) keep canary at 1%, 2) pin embed-route for canary-2 to embed-large-v1 (fallback variant) for next ~10m, 3) run a quick heatup to warm kvcache, 4) re-evaluate metrics after 10m. If errors persist, we'll revert traffic and open rollback. Agree?

jason: Agree. Pushing pin now: `rctl routes pin embed-route canary-2 --variant embed-large-v1 --duration 10m`

deploy-bot: Route pin applied to canary-2: embed-route -> embed-large-v1 for 10m. (cmd: rctl/2045)

sre-bot: Noted. Monitoring windows: p95, 5xx, kv_cache.miss_rate, batch_latency. I'll post snapshots T+5m and T+10m.

maria: Adding short release note update: "Canary for v3.2.4 temporarily pinned to embed-large-v1 due to early embed p95 increase; monitoring." I'll push to release-notes channel after we confirm state.

oliver: Running heatup script now (low-QPS warm key fanout). Will report when done.

(just after 10m) sre-bot: Snapshot T+10m: p95 for embed-route on canary-2 dropped to 920ms, 5xx rate normalized to baseline. kv_cache.miss_rate 0.38 now. No new ERR_BATCH_TIMEOUTs in last 5m.

maria: Looks good. Resume rollout to step 2? If everyone thumbs up I'll move to 20% then continue ramp. :thumbsup:

kim: :+1: prefer to go slow. Increase to 10% first for 5m, then 20%.

jason: Agreed. I'll keep an eye on traces and attach any anomalies.

deploy-bot: Increasing canary-2 traffic to 10%. Next automated check in 5m.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the release notes and close this thread once roll reaches 50%. Keep posting if anything regresses.

jason: quick follow-up — filing a short postmortem note to track root cause: likely kv cache warm-up + batch timeout sensitivity. Will draft and share.

maria: appreciated.
